title: 7 best practices for Facebook retargeting ads — WasteNot

facts.fact: Facebook Ads Manager accounts for 18% of total digital advertising spend in 2023, according to Statista as cited by the page.
facts.quote: accounting for [18% of total digital advertising spend in 2023](https://www.statista.com/

facts.fact: Facebook has over 3 billion users across a portfolio of apps and services.
facts.quote: With over 3 billion users across a portfolio of apps and services, Facebook offers marketers a unique opportunity

facts.fact: Average Facebook ad costs increased significantly since 2019, per Business of Apps as cited by the page.
facts.quote: as average Facebook ad costs have [increased significantly since 2019]

facts.fact: McKinsey & Co. reported that 71% of customers expect personalization.
facts.quote: McKinsey & Co. recently reported](https://www.mckinsey.com/capabilities/growth-marketing-and-sales/our-insights/the-value-of-getting-personalization-right-or-wrong-is-multiplying) that 71% of customers expect personalization

facts.fact: McKinsey & Co. reported that 76% of customers get frustrated when their experiences with brands aren't personalized.
facts.quote: 76% of customers actually get frustrated when their experiences with brands aren’t personalized.

facts.fact: Retargeting via the Meta pixel is limited to users who visited the advertiser's properties within the last 180 days.
facts.quote: you can only retarget users that have visited your properties within the last 180 days

facts.fact: Facebook attributes a conversion to an ad only if it occurs within 28 days of ad exposure.
facts.quote: can only attribute a conversion to an ad if it occurs within 28 days of ad exposure

facts.fact: Advantage+ catalog ads require defining 20 or more products in Ads Manager.
facts.quote: All you need to do is define 20 or more products in Ads Manager, launch your campaign

facts.fact: The page states that the Meta pixel must be included in a website cookie policy if used to track user activity, per the GDPR.
facts.quote: it must be included in your website cookie policy as per [the GDPR]

facts.fact: Recent Google research, as cited by the page, found the chance of a user bouncing increases by 32% when page load time increases from 1 to 3 seconds.
facts.quote: found that the chance of a user bouncing increases by 32% when page load time increases from 1 to 3 seconds

facts.fact: Recent Google research, as cited by the page, found the chance of a user bouncing increases by 90% when page load time increases from 1 to 5 seconds.
facts.quote: and by 90% when page load time increases from 1 to 5 seconds

facts.fact: According to a McKinsey source cited by the page, 71% of customers expect personalization.
facts.quote: 71% of customers expect personalization, and 76% of customers actually get frustrated when their experiences with brands aren’t personalized

facts.fact: The page defines ROAS as the amount of revenue generated per dollar invested in an advertising campaign.
facts.quote: measures the amount of revenue generated per dollar invested in an advertising campaign
